title: Palette quantiser and checker (Lospec .hex/.gpl/.pal/.txt/.png palettes)
summary: Maps images to a fixed pixel-art palette in OKLab with optional Bayer or Floyd-Steinberg dithering and reports off-palette pixels, so mixed packs read as one art style.
description: No palettes are bundled; download one from its Lospec page and credit the palette author.
examples: python lospec_palette_quantiser.py quantise tiles.png --palette endesga-32.hex --out tiles_e32.png --dither bayer4
